messages.subject: DIC giving INF
parts:
Dear all,

My SPDE model is giving a DIC=Inf when I added a couple of covariates. I have tried different priors on theta in vain. Attached is the output of res$dic.. Is that a sign that my model is bad?

Any help would be appreciated.

Best wishes,

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] DIC giving INF
parts:
Hi.

you may look the the individual DIC's and see who is Inf which is the
cause of the problems.

Usually, this is caused by to much uncertainty (read, to flexible
model), so that it overflows when taking that into account. So its more
a sign that the model is 'no good' (yet) than a numerical error.

H
